capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: ArenaEV Model S Plaid 2021: 100 kWh total (EVSpecifications: 99 kWh, 7,920 cells, 5 modules). Long Range/AWD cars (92.6 kWh usable of 100 in an ArenaEV search snippet) and Plaid share the Palladium pack. (2020 page applied to 2021).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Palladium-pack sibling (Model S Plaid, ArenaEV page: 100 kWh total, 92.3 kWh usable; EVSpecifications 99 kWh) applied to this trim, year or model. ArenaEV Model S Plaid 2021: 92.3 kWh usable (same figure on the 2021 and 2025 pages). Applied to the Long Range/AWD cars: same pack (the Palladium LR and Plaid share 99-100 kWh).

chemistry.notes: EVSpecifications 2017-2018 Model S/X: NCA (Panasonic NCR18650A, LiNiCoAlO2); Wikipedia Model S: NCA cathode.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Pack voltage 300-407 V (EVSpecifications: 302 V 75 kWh, 346 V 85/90 kWh, 400-407 V 100 kWh; ArenaEV 300-360 V), well below 800 V: 400 V class.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla release note (software 2020.24.6, Electrek) for Model S/X: "when you navigate to a Supercharger, your car will condition its battery during the drive"; lineup-wide software feature. No manual control found; tesla.com manuals are blocked (403). Cars without navigation or on the oldest MCU1 hardware (2012-2017) may not run it: unconfirmed.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: EVSpecifications 2023/2025 Model S and X Plaid: DC max 250 kW; carried to 2021 (another year of the same hardware). The EVSpecifications 2021 Plaid page says 200 kW; InsideEVs 2021 gives 250 kW for Model S/X Long Range and a 15-minute 187-mile Plaid claim.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: EVSpecifications Model S Plaid (2023, 2025): AC 11.5 kW (240 V, 48 A); carried to 2021. a higher-amperage charger was optional on some cars; standard recorded.
